description: This file contains Angular components and modules related to tooltips for SCADA symbols in the Thingsboard platform, including panels for adding, updating, and removing tags, as well as editing state render functions and click actions.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolPanelComponent
classes.description: Abstract base class for SCADA symbol tooltip panels, providing view initialization logic.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolAddTagPanelComponent
classes.description: Component for the 'Add Tag' tooltip panel with a button to trigger adding a tag.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolTagInputPanelComponent
classes.description: Component for inputting a tag, supporting add/update operations with focus and blur handling.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolTagPanelComponent
classes.description: Component displaying tag information with options to update or remove the tag.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolRemoveTagConfirmComponent
classes.description: Confirmation component for removing a tag, with localized delete text.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolTagSettingsComponent
classes.description: Component for editing tag settings, including state render function and click action toggles.

methods.name: setupAddTagPanelTooltip
methods.description: Sets up tooltip for adding a tag to a SCADA symbol element.

methods.name: setupTagPanelTooltip
methods.description: Sets up tooltip for viewing and editing a tag on a SCADA symbol element.

methods.name: setTooltipComponent
methods.description: Creates and attaches a tooltip component to a symbol element, managing its lifecycle and content.
